title: DNA extraction for human microbe samples
author: Lilan Hao
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcmriu56

steps.title: Add TE buffer and lysozyme
steps.instruction: Combine 200 μL sample with 500 μL TE buffer and 20 μL of 10 mg/mL lysozyme solution in a tube.

steps.title: Lysozyme digestion and pellet removal
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C for 90 min, inverting the tube every 15 min; then centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Add proteinase K and SDS
steps.instruction: Add 300 μL of 20 mg/mL proteinase K and 5 μL of 10 % SDS to the pellet, vortex to resuspend cells.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate in a shaking water bath at 55 °C for 120 min, inverting the tube every 15 min.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and transfer the supernatant to a nuclease‑free 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 700 μL phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), vortex to mix, centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, and transfer the aqueous phase to a new nuclease‑free 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Chloroform wash
steps.instruction: Add 700 μL chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol (24:1), vortex to mix, centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, and transfer the supernatant to a nuclease‑free 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 1/10 volume of 3 M sodium acetate, 2 μL of 5 mg/mL glycogen, and 800 μL cold isopropanol; incubate at –20 °C overnight.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 800 μL 70 % ethanol, centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add another 800 μL 70 % ethanol, centrifuge as above, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Allow the pellet to air‑dry for 15 min.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 1× TE buffer (volume sufficient to dissolve).

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 1 μL RNase A, invert to mix, and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.
